map.name: Defense Challenge
map.testedVersion: Full selected-artifact deterministic audit across the closed Defense game model: six fixed arenas, 15 levels, residency/start, reset/reuse, wave/entity settlement, flag/pathing, inventory/kit/shop/economy, death/respawn/reconnect, retry/checkpoint, terminal/result, and cross-arena isolation. Historical v1.1.1 findings were revalidated as regression pressure. No new current gameplay BUG or DESIGN_MISMATCH is promoted without selected-artifact reachability and player consequence proof.
